author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಮರಣದಲಿ ಜತೆನಿಲರು ಹುಟ್ಟಿನಲಿ ಜೊತೆಯಿರದೆ
ಹರವಿರುವ ಬದುಕಿನಲಿ ಮಾನವನು ಒಂಟಿ
ನಿರತವಿಹ ಸಂಗದಲಿ ನೋವುನಲಿವನು ಸಹಿಸೆ
ಮರೆಯುವನು ಒಂಟಿತನ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: None stand with us in death; none were with us at birth;
in the wide sprawl of life, a person is alone;
bearing pain and joy in constant company,
he forgets his loneliness, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: We are born and die alone. In between, good company that shares our joys and sorrows lets us forget that loneliness.
